description: This file is a C source code for a test client used to perform SRP (Secure Remote Password) authentication. It interacts with the user to input credentials and communicates with the SRP protocol functions to establish session keys, verify server responses, and perform authentication steps.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: The main function orchestrates user input and communication with SRP protocol functions to perform authentication and session key establishment. It handles input for username, password, salt, and server responses, calling relevant functions from external SRP library headers.
